description: Périmètre de 500 mètres autour des gares is a dataset listed in Grand Paris Grand Est open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Grand Paris Grand Est. Données représentant les périmètres de 500 mètres autour des gares en service repérées au document graphique. Consulter le Plan Local d'Urbanisme Intercommunal. Coverage: Grand Paris Grand Est. The portal files it under Town planning, Housing and Spatial planning. Its keywords are PLUI, Périmètres et linéaires particuliers, emplacements réservés. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gpge-portal.
